# Set-Up

## Libraries

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Project Specific Functions

```{r}
source("03_scripts/01_functions.R")
```


# Import Data

```{r}
rts <- read_sf("../RTSMapping_v2_products/2025q3/south_rts_candidates.gpkg")
```

```{r}
domain <- read_sf("../RTSmapping_v2/domain/circumpolar_south_domain.geojson")
```


# Prep Data

## Remove 180th Meridian Polygon Break in Domain

```{r}
domain <- domain |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(id = 1:n())

# 330 is kamchatka, 443 is Wrangell East, 444 is Wrangell West, 445 is mainland Russia
domain$geometry[330] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(
  domain$geometry[330],
  dist = 0.000014
)
domain$geometry[443] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(
  domain$geometry[443],
  dist = 0.000014
)
domain$geometry[444] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(
  domain$geometry[444],
  dist = 0.000014
)
domain$geometry[445] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(
  domain$geometry[445],
  dist = 0.000014
)

domain <- domain |>
  select(-id) |>
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(domain)
  ) |>
  st_transform(st_crs(rts_pt))

st_write(
  domain,
  "./01_processed_data/domain_clean.geojson"
)
```

## Filter High Probability RTS

```{r}
rts_high <- rts |>
  filter(conf_class == "high") |>
  mutate(rts_id = as.integer(rts_id)) |>
  st_transform(6931) # NSIDC EASE-Grid 2.0 North

rts_high_pt <- rts_high |>
  st_centroid() |>
  # assume any RTS that fall outside the domain are false positives and remove
  # (they are there because we didn't clip basemap grids to the domain)
  # this is slow so only doing for pts for now (manual review will most likely fix this problem)
  st_intersection(domain)
```

# Save Output

```{r}
st_write(
  rts_high,
  "01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_poly.geojson"
)

st_write(
  rts_high_pt,
  "01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_pt.geojson"
)
```
